status: Defines the release candidate for interactive deployment (L-D13, 2026-10-15): the committed content of the included top-level paths, identified by a digest of their git blobs. Every tracked top-level path must be listed in exactly one of the two lists; an unlisted path makes the candidate undefined (default deny).
